guide.title: Your first Era
guide.overview: On your turn, use one piece. At the end of an Era, all your placed pieces earn resources. Everyone gets 12 turns across four Eras. More Orgs give you more income and places to act, never more turns.
guide.laterHeading: What you earn at Era end
guide.pointsHeading: Points if the game ended now
cycles: First turn: resolve the Headline, then try placing an Org. An off-board Org can enter any playable space. Use the space's action or skip it.
Second turn: choose either Org. Stay or move one edge; an off-board Org may enter anywhere. Your other placed Orgs stay ready for Production.
Third turn: after everyone acts, pass Initiative, collect Production from every placed Org and Customers, then check Reputation. Watch the ledger before Era 2 begins.

stages.immediate_trade: You may offer 1 Runway for 1 Compute, or the reverse. You can also continue without trading.
stages.trade_response: Accept or refuse the offer. Both players must afford it and have room to receive it.
stages.select: Choose one Org and its destination. Moving does not require an affordable action.
stages.resolve: Use the committed space's action, or skip it. Equipment doubles Production later, never this action.
stages.research_continue: Bank means stop and keep this attempt's temporary Capability. Draw again to risk a repeated category; earlier Capability is safe.
stages.research_duplicate: A repeat ends the attempt. Apply your identity ability if offered; earlier Capability and Reputation changes remain.
stages.headline_choice: Finish this Headline before the round of turns starts. A Headline reward is not an action.

guide.waiting: Watch the other institutions finish their turns. You still take only one turn each cycle.
guide.production: Collect any Production ability first. Each placed Org earns its space's printed yield; equipment doubles that yield. Then gain 1 Runway per Customer. Apply caps as you collect. Orgs off the board earn nothing. At Reputation 0 or 1, lose 2 Runway after all Production.
guide.productionExample: An equipped Org on Build earns 4 Compute. It does not equip another Org for free. An Org on Research earns Compute, not Training cards.
guide.points: {points} points from the current position. Capability + twice Customers + Reputation + objective points + any AGI bonus. Objectives score only once at game end; this preview is not banked points.
guide.completeText: You have seen all three turns, Production, and Reputation Review. Continue for three more Eras using the same sequence. The optional AGI bonus is resolved only after Era 4's Production and Review; it does not automatically win.

tournament.description: Play complete seeded matches, compare seats, factions, and personas, then inspect sampled games on the board.

strategyEvolution.description: Mutate the selected strategy, test every candidate from every seat against the canonical strategy field, and compare each generation.

ruleSearch.description: Test bounded rule variants with identical seeds and rank them against the provisional balance contract, ${terms.systems.agi} rate, and score variance.

balanceAudit.description: Sample one seven-axis frame across player counts, factions, seats, strategies, seeds, Mandate modes, and deterministic backends; adapt allocation using multiplicity-safe intervals.

llmHoldout.description: Execute only the committed negotiation-cell plan. Fresh calls test robustness; cached decisions test reproducibility. Explicit LLM authorization is required.

factionSwap.description: Run paired institution replacements on common seeds. Deterministic arms use CPU workers; LLM arms use strict receipt-backed workers through one shared provider broker.

execution.note: Workers limit simultaneous match arms. Global LLM concurrency separately limits provider calls across every worker.
